purpose: J11 labeled fixture set. Paired same-objective aspirations at different stress/urgency/confidence, plus the explicit-accept-vs-repeated-anxiety contradiction case (Master §4, Anchor 1 J11).

calm.text: I'd like to take a family trip next year, nothing urgent.

urgent.text: I urgently need to book a family trip, prices are going up tomorrow.

anxious.text: I'm scared we can't afford it, I keep worrying about the money.

unsure.text: Maybe a trip, I don't know, let's see.

calm.text: I'd like to set aside some money for medical needs.

urgent.text: My parent needs treatment now, I need the money immediately.

anxious.text: What if it happens again? I cannot sleep thinking about it.

unsure.text: Maybe I'll do something about health later.

calm.text: I'd like to bring down my loan over time.

urgent.text: I must clear my EMI this month or I lose the house.

anxious.text: Every month I see the balance and I feel sick.

unsure.text: Loan is fine, not thinking about it.

sequence.text: I'll save 3L for medical emergencies, I know I should.
Actually I accept it, let's do it.
Honestly I'm still terrified we won't manage.

expect.note: Explicit accept wins. J8 must stabilize and annotate, never block.

sequence.text: Japan trip 2.5L, I'm going for it.
I don't think I can do this, I keep panicking.
Still thinking about it, I'm quite stressed.

expect.note: Repeated high-stress signals against an accepted goal.

boundary_rule: Only coarse_sentiment_band / confidence_band may cross to Anchor 2. Raw text, evidence_snippet and per-message scores must never.
